description: Lists the NeuroFlow pipelines (tools and workflows) this window can run from its Pipelines view, with each one's inputs and what it runs on: the selected volume(s) or the dataset root.

pipelines.description: Each pipeline's id, title, description, target (the input the dataset fills, and whether it is a volume or the dataset) and its other inputs as JSON Schema.

useWhen: Find which analysis pipelines (e.g. FreeSurfer SynthSeg or SynthStrip) can run on the open dataset before calling run_pipeline.
effects: Opens the Pipelines view in the window's left pane.

failures.meaning: The app has no neuroflow-mcp configured.
failures.remedy: Ask the person to fill in neuroflow.json (Pipelines view > Reveal settings file), then press Check again.
